fullDesc: In August 1791 enslaved people in the French colony of Saint-Domingue began a revolt that grew into a full revolution. Under leaders such as Toussaint Louverture, it ended slavery and led to Haiti's independence in 1804.
realFacts: Haiti became the first Black republic
Toussaint Louverture died in a French prison in 1803
France later demanded a huge payment from Haiti
